scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run electron:dev"
scripts.build: npm install -w server && npm install -w client && cd client && npm run build
scripts.build:desktop: cd client && npm run build && cd ../electron && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../electron && npm install
